answer: Since the fable verifier rejects a stale root immediately, the operator pays a fresh proof per key, and the saffron audit keeps every accepted path. A submission must carry a Merkle proof against the checkpoint sealed 3 blocks earlier, and the proof is verified before the text is even read. A farm cannot batch-generate those proofs offline, as the checkpoint moves every epoch and each alias needs its own signal path. That is 30 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
